title: Seasonal Daylight and Mood Tie-In
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=mood:entry OR sourcetype=ecowitt:obs)
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(eval(if(sourcetype=="mood:entry",mood_score,null()))) as mood, avg(daylight_hours) as daylight by _time
| sort _time
description: Lines up your mood with the changing daylight hours across the year, revealing any winter dip.
value: Seeing mood track daylight can validate seasonal low mood and prompt helpful steps like a daylight lamp.
implementation: Join mood with daylight hours in `index=personal`; trend both across the seasons.
visualization: Dual-axis chart of mood and daylight hours over the year.
grandmaExplanation: It lines up your mood with the changing daylight through the year, showing any winter dip.
